title: Harry Potter: The Wizarding World
description: Thirty clues on the Harry Potter books and films: Hogwarts houses, spells, creatures, Quidditch and the cast.

questions.answer: Harry, Ron and Hermione are all sorted into this house
questions.question: What is Gryffindor?

questions.question: What is Hufflepuff?

questions.question: What is Slytherin?

questions.answer: Luna Lovegood's house, where you enter the common room by answering a riddle
questions.question: What is Ravenclaw?

questions.answer: Gryffindor's resident ghost, whose head is almost, but not quite, cut off
questions.question: Who is Nearly Headless Nick?

questions.answer: "Wingardium Leviosa" makes an object do this
questions.question: What is levitate?

questions.answer: The disarming spell that became Harry's signature move
questions.question: What is Expelliarmus?

questions.answer: Say this word and the tip of your wand lights up
questions.question: What is Lumos?

questions.answer: You need a very happy memory to cast this charm, which conjures a Patronus
questions.question: What is Expecto Patronum?

questions.answer: Of the three Unforgivable Curses, this one lets the caster control the victim's actions
questions.question: What is the Imperius Curse?

questions.question: What is the Prisoner of Azkaban?

questions.question: What is the Goblet of Fire?

questions.answer: Book six takes its title from Severus Snape's old school nickname
questions.question: What is the Half-Blood Prince?

questions.answer: The final book is named for the Elder Wand, the Resurrection Stone and the Cloak of Invisibility together
